verdict.rationale: Navan's Ava assistant and MCP integration provide AI-generated insights directly from travel/expense data — analyzing spend, summarizing by category, comparing to policy, predicting future spend, and flagging policy violations via natural language queries. This is well documented across first-party docs and blog content with concrete example prompts/outputs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of insight accuracy and no evidence of proactive (unprompted) suggestion surfacing inside the core product UI beyond chat-based queries.
